method: VOLE `view` serves each pre-registered query from the indexed descriptor and reports its ObservationStats plus wall/CPU/peak-RSS from /usr/bin/time -v; every served slice is byte-compared (cmp) against the source. Each sequential baseline is timed directly with /usr/bin/time -v while a FIFO-fed consumer closes after the target output offset; gzip/zstd/xz decompress the same prefix (a+len bytes) and `pv -b -n` counts the compressed bytes read. CPU time is user+sys.
caveats: v1 `view` reads and parses the whole framed descriptor into RAM, so on-disk I/O bytes are NOT reduced; descriptor_bytes_traversed is a CPU-side approximation. OS page cache dominates wall time; CPU time is the less noisy comparator.
